description.value: Hillside Winery & Bistro is a 40-year-old estate winery on the Naramata Bench, set among hillside terraces overlooking Okanagan Lake. The bistro seats 65 indoors plus two outdoor patios, serving terroir-to-table small plates built around local and foraged Okanagan ingredients. Naramata Road is a beloved cycling corridor through BC wine country, making this a natural destination stop for touring riders.
